facts.fact: The Minister of Digital Transformation opened a workshop on 7 June 2024 presenting the national Tamakkun platform, built with German cooperation (GIZ), to train public servants in basic digital skills.

systems.owner: Ministry of Digital Transformation, Innovation and Administrative Modernisation

MRT.note: Data protection appears only as a skills topic; no law is stated.
The platform is for public servants, with job seekers also named as users; no programme for the public is stated.
The National Digital Agenda 2022-2025 is named, with no adoption or text status stated.
